name: io.github.atushi1841/japan-market-mcp
description: Compare used-good prices across 9 Japanese shops plus Rakuten and MAFF wholesale data.
long_description:
# Japan Market MCP

Compare used-good prices across leading Japanese shops in a single MCP tool call.

## Tools (14)

| Tool | Market |
|------|--------|
| `search_camera_market` | Used cameras & lenses (Kitamura + Fujiya) |
| `search_watch_market` | Luxury watches (Jackroad + Kitamura) |
| `search_luxury_market` | Used luxury brands (Komehyo + Jackroad) |
| `search_instrument_market` | Used instruments (Digimart + Ishibashi) |
| `search_offmall_market` | General used goods (Hard Off, 800+ stores) |
| `search_kakaku_prices` | New price comparison (Kakaku.com) |
| `search_car_market` | Used cars by body type (goo-net) |
| `search_car_price_stats` | Used car price stats (min/max/avg/median) |
| `search_rakuten_items` | Rakuten Ichiba product search (official API) |
| `get_rakuten_ranking` | Rakuten best-seller ranking (official API) |
| `get_maff_market_report` | MAFF wholesale market report (open data) |
| `search_maff_price_trend` | MAFF wholesale price trend (open data) |
| `get_maff_top_movers` | MAFF YoY price top movers (open data) |
| `get_maff_markets` | List available MAFF wholesale markets (open data) |

## Pricing
$0.001 per Apify event call. MAFF endpoints are free (open data).

## Requirements
Python >=3.10, uv. Set `APIFY_TOKEN` environment variable.

## Repository
https://github.com/atushi1841/japan-market-mcp

## Apify Store
https://apify.com/fruitful_quintessence/japan-market-mcp

tools.name: search_camera_market
tools.description: Compare used camera & lens prices across Japanese shops (Kitamura + Fujiya Camera). Returns price, condition, shop name, URL per item.

tools.name: search_watch_market
tools.description: Compare luxury watch prices across Japanese shops (Jackroad + Kitamura used watches). Returns price, condition, shop name, URL per item.

tools.name: search_luxury_market
tools.description: Compare used luxury brand prices across Japanese shops (Komehyo + Jackroad). Returns price, condition, brand, shop name, URL per item.

tools.name: search_instrument_market
tools.description: Compare used musical instrument prices across Japanese shops (Digimart + Ishibashi U-BOX). Returns price, condition, shop name, URL per item.

tools.name: search_offmall_market
tools.description: Search OffMall (Japan's largest 2nd-hand marketplace, Hard Off official, 800+ stores). Returns price, condition, shop, URL per item.

tools.name: search_kakaku_prices
tools.description: Search Kakaku.com — Japan's largest price comparison site — for lowest prices, shop counts and ratings.

tools.name: search_car_market
tools.description: Search goo-net — Japan's largest used car portal — by body type for current inventory. Returns price, mileage, condition, shop, URL per item.

tools.name: search_car_price_stats
tools.description: Get used car market price statistics (min/max/avg/median JPY) for a model keyword from goo-net. Useful for arbitrage decisions.

tools.name: search_rakuten_items
tools.description: Search Rakuten Ichiba products via official Rakuten API. Returns item name, price, shop, URL, review count.

tools.name: get_rakuten_ranking
tools.description: Get Rakuten Ichiba best-seller ranking via official API. Returns top items by genre.

tools.name: get_maff_market_report
tools.description: MAFF wholesale vegetable/fruit market report (旬別, official open data). Returns JPY/100kg and YoY% per market.

tools.name: search_maff_price_trend
tools.description: MAFF fresh produce wholesale price trend across markets and periods. Official open data.

tools.name: get_maff_top_movers
tools.description: MAFF fresh produce YoY price top movers at a market. Supply-shock signal. Official open data.

tools.name: get_maff_markets
tools.description: List available MAFF wholesale markets nationwide. No API key required.
